notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
set -eu
tvnum=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum)
tvnode=$(printf '/dev/bus/usb/007/%03d' "$tvnum")
echo '@@ boot'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ sysfsRealpath'
readlink -f /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1
echo '@@ sysfsStat'
stat -L -c "%d:%i" /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1
echo '@@ busnum'
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/busnum
echo '@@ devnum'
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum
echo '@@ deviceNode'
echo "$tvnode"
echo '@@ nodeStat'
stat -L -c "%t:%T:%i" "$tvnode"
echo '@@ descriptorsSha256'
sha256sum /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/descriptors | cut -d " " -f1
echo '@@ configuration'
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/bConfigurationValue
echo '@@ authorized'
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/authorized
echo '@@ runtimeStatus'
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/power/runtime_status
echo '@@ interfaceNumber'
awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceNumber
echo '@@ alternate'
awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bAlternateSetting
echo '@@ interfaceClass'
awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceClass
echo '@@ interfaceSubClass'
awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceSubClass
echo '@@ interfaceProtocol'
awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceProtocol
test ! -e /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
test ! -L /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
echo "@@ USB_LIFECYCLE"
dmesg | sed -n "/usb 7-1/p" | tail -12
echo "@@ UPTIME"
cat /proc/uptime
